title: AI efficiency
description: How efficiently AI coding tools use context and credits, from the ai_normalized stream.

panels.title: Cache read % of context
panels.description: Share of input context read from the cache.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(((CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' THEN ai_input_tokens - COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0) ELSE ai_input_tokens END) + COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0))), 0), 1) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background'

panels.title: Average context per call
panels.description: Average input context per model call.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(((CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' THEN ai_input_tokens - COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0) ELSE ai_input_tokens END) + COALESCE(ai_cache_read_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0))), 0) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background'

panels.title: Failed agent tool calls
panels.description: Share of agent tool calls that failed.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ai_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'tool'

panels.title: Agent tool failures
panels.description: Agent tools with failed calls, by AI tool.

queries.query: SELECT ai_tool_name AS "tool", ai_source AS "source", COUNT(*) AS "calls", SUM(CASE WHEN ai_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "failed", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ai_success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "failed_pct" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'tool' GROUP BY ai_tool_name, ai_source ORDER BY "failed" DESC, "calls" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Cache write credits by break length
panels.description: Estimated credits spent on writing context to the cache, grouped by the break since the previous call in the same conversation. The cache expires after about 5 minutes without use, so the first call after a longer break writes the whole context again.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN "pause" IS NULL THEN 'first call' WHEN "pause" < 1 THEN 'under 1 min' WHEN "pause" < 5 THEN '1-5 min' WHEN "pause" < 60 THEN '5-60 min' ELSE 'over 1 h' END AS "x_axis_1", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (ai_provider IN ('github', 'github-copilot')) THEN NULL WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18' OR ai_agent = 'XtabProvider' THEN 0 WHEN ai_model = 'claude-opus-5.5' THEN (500 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'claude-sonnet-5.5' THEN (250 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'claude-haiku-4.5' THEN (125 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' THEN (125 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-6.1-sol' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-6-luna' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-5.6-sol' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-5.6-terra' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gpt-5.6-luna' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 WHEN ai_model = 'gemini-3.8-flash' THEN (0 * COALESCE(ai_cache_write_tokens, 0)) / 1000000.0 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS "y_axis_1", "tool" AS "breakdown_1" FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END AS "tool" FROM (SELECT *, (_timestamp - LAG(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY ai_conversation_id ORDER BY _timestamp)) / 60000000.0 AS "pause" FROM "ai_normalized" WHERE ai_event_kind = 'inference' AND operation_name NOT LIKE 'ai-normalization.smoke%' AND CASE WHEN ai_source = 'vscode_copilot' AND (ai_agent IN ('XtabProvider', 'progressMessages', 'title', 'intentDetection', 'healApplyPatch') OR ai_agent LIKE 'copilotLanguageModelWrapper%') THEN 'vscode_copilot background' ELSE ai_source END <> 'vscode_copilot background')) GROUP BY "x_axis_1", "breakdown_1" ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE("pause", -1))
